description_en: Queries the details of a data tracking ticket
description_zh: 获取数据追踪工单详情
name: GetDataTrackOrderDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

DatabaseSearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database

JobEndTime.description_en: The end time of the time range in which data operations are tracked. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
JobEndTime.description_zh: 数据追踪范围的结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

JobStartTime.description_en: The start time of the time range in which data operations are tracked. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
JobStartTime.description_zh: 数据追踪范围的起始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

JobStatus.description_en:
The status of the data tracking task. Valid values:

INIT: The task is being initialized.
LISTING: The binary logs are being obtained.
LIST_SUCCESS: The binary logs are successfully obtained.
DOWNLOADING: The binary logs are being downloaded.
DOWNLOAD_FAIL: The binary logs failed to be downloaded.
DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS: The binary logs are successfully downloaded.
FILTERING: The binary logs are being parsed.
FILTER_FAIL: The binary logs failed to be parsed.
FILTER_SUCCESS: The binary logs are successfully parsed
JobStatus.description_zh:
数据追踪任务状态，取值和说明如下：
INIT：任务初始化。
LISTING：正在获取Binlog列表。
LIST_SUCCESS：获取Binlog列表完成。
DOWNLOADING：正在下载Binlog。
DOWNLOAD_FAIL：下载Binlog失败。
DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS：下载Binlog完成。
FILTERING：正在解析Binlog。
FILTER_FAIL：解析Binlog失败。
FILTER_SUCCESS：解析Binlog完成

Logic.description_en:

Logic.description_zh:
